title: StudioDeurbel's Emerald Enlarged
description: This project adds emerald armor and tools.
body:
![Mod Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0bd1adafccd773bf0cb6f437bdc08ff4402d2096.png)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This mod **finally** adds emerald armor and tools to Minecraft! The tools and armor are both in a tier between iron and diamond, and are the perfect extra equipment choises for the Minecraft show-offs! This mod also adds two new advancements.
